info.title: DLog
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

client.description: Client entity and its corresponding value of this sub_module.

column.description: Column entity and its corresponding value of this sub_module.

instance.description: Instance entity and its corresponding value of this sub_module.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 entity and its corresponding value of this sub_module.

mac.description: Mac entity and its corresponding value of this sub_module.

port.description: Port entity and its corresponding value of this sub_module.

table.description: Table entity and its corresponding value of this sub_module.

ubt_zone.description: UBT Zone entity and its corresponding value of this sub_module.

vlan.description: Vlan entity and its corresponding value of this sub_module.

vrf.description: Vrf entity and its corresponding value of this sub_module.

module.description:
Reference Resource: [DLog](#/DLog)
Name of the debug module. All keyword is to enable all debug modules.

sub_module.description:
Reference Resource: [DLog](#/DLog)
Name of the sub_module of this module. All keyword is to enable all sub_modules of this module.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
